summary: National Grid plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying its 2026/27 Half Year Results Statement (period ended 30 September 2026), announced to the London Stock Exchange on 5 November 2026. The exhibit is a routine interim earnings release with financial statements and segment disclosures, incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is an ordinary periodic results filing, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
